dependencies.install_scope: Reuse existing host Docker image by immutable digest; ephemeral containers and temporary fixture/output directories only. No pull, install, upgrade, repository writes, or service.
dependencies.cleanup_plan: Containers use --rm and fixture/output directories use Python TemporaryDirectory; remove only check-owned temporary artifacts. Retain the pre-existing shared image.
dependencies.verification_recipe:
/opt/conda/bin/python3.12 - <<'PY'
import json, os, pathlib, subprocess, tempfile
image = 'structurizr/structurizr@sha256:c89b54231c42da90484e6bf4e398f36a40123cb4b12c9d5f09c27eef3dc9644c'
inspected = json.loads(subprocess.check_output(['docker','image','inspect',image], text=True, timeout=10))[0]
assert image in inspected['RepoDigests']
assert (inspected['Os'], inspected['Architecture']) == ('linux','amd64')
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='epic034-c4-check-') as directory:
    root = pathlib.Path(directory)
    root.chmod(0o755)
    (root/'workspace.dsl').write_text('workspace {\n model {\n  reviewer = person "Reviewer"\n  cascade = softwareSystem "Cascade"\n  reviewer -> cascade "Reviews plans"\n }\n views {\n  systemContext cascade "context" {\n   include *\n   autoLayout lr\n  }\n }\n}\n')
    base = ['docker','run','--rm','--pull=never','--network=none','--read-only','--cap-drop=ALL','--security-opt=no-new-privileges','--pids-limit=256','--memory=1536m','--cpus=2','--tmpfs','/tmp:rw,size=512m','--user',f'{os.getuid()}:{os.getgid()}','-e','HOME=/tmp','-e','PLAYWRIGHT_SKIP_BROWSER_DOWNLOAD=1','-v',f'{directory}:/usr/local/structurizr:rw',image]
    for args in [['validate','-workspace','workspace.dsl'],['export','-workspace','workspace.dsl','-format','json','-output','out'],['export','-workspace','workspace.dsl','-format','svg','-output','out']]:
        subprocess.run(base+args, check=True, timeout=55)
    model = json.loads((root/'out/workspace.json').read_text())
    assert model['views']['systemContextViews'][0]['key'] == 'context'
    assert '<svg' in (root/'out/context.svg').read_text()
print('PASS structurizr 2026.09.19-playwright sha256:c89b54231c42da90484e6bf4e398f36a40123cb4b12c9d5f09c27eef3dc9644c: offline DSL validation, JSON export, SVG render')
PY
